mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a two-story home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting a contractor for a two-story addition requires thorough research into their experience with similar projects, licensing, insurance, and client references. It's important to choose a company with a proven track record in complex structural work. During your decision process, consider how a contractor communicates and their ability to manage projects efficiently, as good communication is vital for a smooth project flow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with proven experience in two-story additions, proper licensing, insurance, and strong client references, prioritizing clear communication and project management skills.
